layouts.name: CBitmapSource_OutsetMargins
layouts.notes: 28000.1/3231: CImage::UpdateRectangle reads +0x98/+0xA0 as negative left/top and +0x9C/+0xA4 as added right/bottom. Independently, CBitmapSource::Create(sub-bitmap) stores the supplied source slice margins at +0x88. These destination outsets expand the image rectangle without changing the source slices; CImage::UpdateBitmap uses NineGridLayout for the native brush.

layouts.name: CBitmapSource_SourceSize
layouts.notes: Create stores the cropped source RECT's dimensions; UpdateButtonVisuals independently reads the height for glyph-fit selection.

layouts.name: CBitmapSource_ContentMargins
layouts.notes: CreateNCButtons copies TMT_CONTENTMARGINS into every background state; UpdateButtonVisuals reads the first normal close-button state's top and bottom values. These are not the nine-grid destination margins.
